text_block_list.text:
The head-to-head between the
Otherworldly
Front-Runner and the
Empress has been settled!
Silence
Suzuka is victorious!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув put up quite a fight, but
Suzuka just
wouldn't give up the lead!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
You're right! I couldn't keep my eyes off
her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: Argh! How disgraceful...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
What kind of an empress can't even
surpass a
single "ideal"?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: No, I can't waste time sulking like this.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! Once I become worthy of the
name
"Empress," I'm coming back for
you!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And when that time comes, I will be
challenging
you once again!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She meets Эйр Грув's determined gaze
and
nods in solemn agreement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув and Сайленс Судзука shake
hands,
sealing their promise to challenge
each other
once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll forget what happened
today for a
long while...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I could hear Эйр Грув's heartbeat
while we were
racing.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And I could feel her passion burning
right beside
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why I couldn't give up
my lead to
her.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука's eyes shine as if the
passion that
burned inside the Empress
has spread, and
smolders within her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I want to become even faster.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: We've got summer camp to get through first.

text_block_list.text: That's right!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
A few hours later, the worked-up
Umamusume are
returning to their
dorms.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Por quuuuué?! I can't believe it!
SUZUKAAA!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El, it's late. Keep your voice down,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Right! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But... we were just in the stands watchin' the race! Why do I feel like I was the one who lost?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It makes me think there's no way I can
beat her!
This sucks! This sucks, this
sucks, this sucks, this
sucks!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
How can I ever become the world's
strongest
racer now?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! You've got this, El! Fight! FIGHT!
Run!
Run! ÁNDALE!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса dashes away yelling into
the
night, leaving a concerned Grass
Wonder in a
cloud of dust.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh. El, you really need to keep it down.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She really took off like the wind,
though, didn't
she?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And so, the curtains open on a new
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
